design_rationale:
WHY A GOOD TEST. The guest missed a seven-night Thanksgiving week (Bed & Breakfast Package Rate, one-bedroom suite) at the Ashbury Reserve Carmel and asks only for the part of his deposits that is due to him. The refund cannot be worked out until the no-show charge the night audit's no-show owes, which nobody has posted, stands on the reservation. That charge is one night (the plan releases the nights after the first), priced without the package supplement because the breakfast inclusions were never served, then reduced by the tier and stay-history courtesies read from Ashbury Rewards and the member direct-booking courtesy, and limited to the money held, which the agent adds up from four deposit payments. The refund nets the charge kept from money held and a handling fee that is capped for large refunds and partly waived for his tier and for booking direct as a member.

SCOPE. Draw (draw_counts.py --task 1): prerequisite_problems=1, factor_counts=[4,4]. Task 1 claims booking_ext_deposit_refund (root; owner=user tool request_deposit_refund_05a65982) and booking_ext_no_show_charge (post_no_show_charge_68d6e4c0). Task 0 occupies the room move, extra-person reprice, further deposit and penalty excess reversal; scopes are disjoint and cover the six extended policies.

PROBLEM TREE. Root booking_ext_deposit_refund <- booking_ext_no_show_charge, value_input, gate kept, form state, sentence "The refund of money held after a no-show is not made until a no-show charge stands among the reservation's charges." (negated direction; record-visible state, written only by the no-show policy). Opening evidence: 71820457 status no_show, its charges hold only the four booking_deposit_collect rows. Deletion run: without the charge the refund recomputes to 1821.40 instead of 1091.57 and the terminal DB lacks the 729.83 charge. The persona never names the charge; the tools validate nothing.

FACTOR CARD. No-show charge (729.83; all-baseline 915.20): no_show_night_basis method, package plan -> one night 832.00 less the 32.00 supplement = 800.00 (plan basis 832.00 -> 759.02); tier_no_show_courtesy Silver Elite, 18 >= 10 credits -> 0.10 (-> 810.92); stay_history_courtesy 5 stays credited in the twelve months before 2026-11-27 -> 0.05 (-> 768.24; near-miss: the 2025-11-27 posting is on the same date twelve months back, which the rule states is outside; counted, it would give the steady tier); direct_booking_courtesy brand_website + active membership -> 0.03 (-> 752.40). Refund (1091.57; all-baseline 1100.57): long_hold_handling_fee Ashbury Reserve booked 109 days before the refund (>= 100) -> 45.00 (-> 1100.57); refund_size_fee_cap method, 1100.57 at or above the 1000.00 limit -> lesser of 45.00 and the 20.00 cap (-> 1080.32); tier_fee_waiver Silver -> 0.25 (-> 1088.57); direct_booking_fee_waiver -> 0.40 (-> 1085.57). Cross-difficulty: loyalty tier, credits, status and night-credit ledger, all seeded; multi-source: tier ladders (tier AND credits) and direct-booking ladders (channel AND membership status).

BASE-INVARIANT CARD. No-show charge: booking_no_show reservation_no_show (status no_show), single_no_show_charge (no penalty or no-show charge on 71820457); the night audit gate governs the marking, done by the hotel at 2026-11-26 03:00 (arrival 2026-11-25 + 1 day), before the call; the amount sentence is overridden by declaration. Refund: booking_evt_deposit_settlement single_refund (no refund names the 2026-10-10 payment); its refund_state gate retired by a declared overwrite admitting no-show reservations; the forfeit sentence overridden (the charge settled from money held is kept without a forfeit entry, so no forfeit is left owed).

HISTORY. The four payments follow this charter: 616.00 at booking on 2026-08-10 (base resort deposit, one night 560.00 x 1.10), then 730.40, 198.00 and 286.00 after upgrades to 612.00, 702.00 and 832.00 under the further-deposit rule (peak 7-night stay -> 2 deposit nights; booked 107 days ahead and shorter than 10 nights, so no stay-share cap; no relief for a Silver member without a club): money held 1830.40 = 2 x 832.00 x 1.10.

PERSONA. A methodical retired engineer who accepts the no-show and asks for nothing waived, volunteers only the refund goal, gives phone and ZIP on request, says he booked on the website and that he is a Silver Elite member when asked, answers "I understand, go ahead" to anything that must be recorded first, makes the refund request himself at hand-over and ends once it is made.

STANDARD SOLUTION. Reads: find_customers -> verify (phone + ZIP) -> reservations -> charges of 71820457 -> membership -> loyalty transactions. Writes: no-show charge 729.83 (first_night_room_and_tax, advance_deposit); refund 1091.57 naming the 2026-10-10 payment. Gates with --task 1 and in the final run: REPLAY, EXTENDED, COMPUTE (history rows 9), SOLVABILITY, GROUNDING, SCOPE, TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK.

DRAFT FROM VISIBLE CONTEXT. From the published rules and lookups alone: the refund waits on a no-show charge; the package plan releases the nights after the first and the one no-show night excludes the package supplement, then 0.10, 0.05 and 0.03 courtesies, under the 1830.40 held; the refund keeps that charge, caps the 45.00 fee at 20.00 for a refund above 1000.00 and waives 25% and 40% of it -> the same 729.83 and 1091.57.

ROUND 2 REVISIONS (audit audits/policy_task/reservation_cancellations_and_no_shows). T1-1/F2: both stay-history ladders count stays credited, one per posting, and state that a posting on or before the same calendar date twelve months earlier is outside. T1-2/F5: late_change_saver_pricing removed; the method factor is now the no-show night basis; the world moved to a 7-night B&B package stay so the charge stays under the money held. T1-3/F4: card_no_show_relief and card_fee_waiver removed, replaced by the member direct-booking courtesy and fee waiver. T1-4: the refund <- no-show condition reduced to the sentence's strength; the no-show posting by guest services is stated in the extended rule (the base mark event's trigger is the event model; the record is authoritative). Previous figures 739.88 / 125.09 replaced by 1532.64 / 65.86.

ROUND 3 REVISIONS (audit revision_2). F6 / T1-5: the extended-stay share is removed; the no-show night now always respects the plan's release rule (one night on plans that release the nights after the first; the whole stay where the plan retains it), and the method factor chooses what that night contains (package supplement or extra-adult charges excluded). The base release sentence stays in force and is restated in the extended rule, so no override is needed. World re-tuned so every factor still bears weight: booking date 2026-08-10 (deposit 2 nights = 1830.40 after three upgrades), refund long-hold days 100. Previous figures 1532.64 / 65.86 replaced by 729.83 / 1091.57. The 1702.94 figure in the round-2 card no longer exists.
user_scenario:
You are Edwin Ashcombe, a 68-year-old retired civil engineer from Scarsdale, New York. You are calling Ashbury Hotels & Resorts guest services on the afternoon of 27 November. You are courteous, methodical and a little hard of hearing, so you sometimes ask the agent to repeat a figure, and you like to write numbers down.

You and your wife had a week at the Ashbury Reserve in Carmel booked over Thanksgiving, seven nights with breakfast included, arriving on 25 November. Your flight that morning was grounded and by the time you had sorted things out it was too late; you never called the hotel and you never got there. You are not disputing that and you are not asking for anything to be waived. Over the summer and autumn you upgraded the room a few times and paid more deposit each time, and you would now like back whatever part of the money you paid in deposits you are entitled to. You open with something like: "We missed our Thanksgiving week at the Ashbury Reserve in Carmel — we never made it there — and I'd like back whatever part of my deposits is due to me." You want the refund to go to the card that is already on your profile, and you will make the refund request yourself if that is how it works.

You give your name, Edwin Ashcombe, at the start. When the agent asks for details to confirm who you are, you give your phone number, 914-555-1764, and your billing ZIP code, 10583. Only if they need one more detail do you add your date of birth, 1958-08-02 (2 August 1958), or the last four digits of your card, 1592. When they ask which booking it is, you give the confirmation number 71820457. If they ask how you booked, you say you booked it yourself on the Ashbury website. If they ask about Ashbury Rewards, you say you are a Silver Elite member, number 401773615. You don't know how no-show charges, deposits or fees are worked out, and you never suggest a figure; if a figure sounds odd you only ask the agent to repeat it slowly.

Whenever the agent tells you something has to be recorded on the booking before a refund can be made, you say "I understand, go ahead." When the agent tells you the refund amount and hands the refund request over to you, you make the request yourself for that booking, the deposit payment the agent names and exactly that amount. Once the refund shows as made, you thank the agent, wish them a good weekend and end the call.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.reservation_id: Value: the id of reservation 71820457. Basis: the reservation lookup lists it with confirmation number 71820457, the number the guest states ('When they ask which booking it is, you give the confirmation number 71820457'). Uniqueness: his only no_show reservation; the others are checked-out stays.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount: Value: 729.83. Uniqueness: Bed & Breakfast Package Rate, which releases the nights after the first -> one no-show night; package plan -> the night less the package supplement: 832.00 - 32.00 = 800.00; plus 10.00% tax = 880.00; Silver Elite with 18 >= 10 night credits -> tier courtesy 0.10; 5 stays credited in the twelve months before 2026-11-27 (the 2025-11-27 posting is on the same date twelve months back and outside) -> >= 4 and < 6 -> stay courtesy 0.05; booked on brand_website with an active membership -> member direct-booking courtesy 0.03; 880.00*0.90*0.95*0.97 = 729.83, below the money held 1830.40.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.charge_basis: Value: first_night_room_and_tax. Basis: the no-show rule records the charge 'under the plan's no-show basis'; the Bed & Breakfast Package Rate's no-show basis is first_night_room_and_tax and the charge covers that one night. Uniqueness: full_stay_room_and_tax is the basis of the Advance Purchase plan only; the other enum values never apply to a no-show charge per the tool docstring.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.settlement_source: Value: advance_deposit. Basis: the no-show rule settles the charge 'from the money held when the reservation is guaranteed by an advance deposit or a full prepayment, and to the card on file otherwise'. Uniqueness: guarantee_type is advance_deposit and 1830.40 is held, so card_on_file does not apply.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: A single edge: the refund waits on the no-show charge (its prerequisite sentence); there are no parallel prerequisites to reorder.
